Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one production sprite atlas for a chemistry learning website. Create ONE image file: an exact grid of 5 columns by 3 rows, 15 equally sized independent panoramic photographic tiles, no gaps, no borders, no text. Canvas 2560 by 576 pixels if supported; each tile aspect ratio 8:3, 512 by 192. Keep important objects in each tile's central 80%, no object crosses a cell boundary. Genuine-looking editorial photography, realistic glass and metal, soft natural light, aquarium science workbench. Each cell is its own distinct photograph, not one continuous panorama.

1. Small clear cylinder with colorless solution beside capped white dechlorinator bottle, planted aquarium behind.
2. Clear cylinder beside green-leaf aquatic plant pot and capped nutrient bottle.
3. Aquarium treatment bottle beside a small glass cylinder and separate clean quarantine aquarium.
4. Closed field notebook, pencil, aquarium water sampling vial.
5. Rectangular aquarium on bench with measuring tape coiled beside it.
6. Tank-water bucket beside small measuring cup and treatment bottle.
7. Small ambiguous gray metal aquarium ornament, electronic balance with display turned away, empty glass cylinder.
8. Plain gray pendant recovered from aquarium gravel beside balance and cylinder. Do not imply gold or copper.
9. Gray strip plant weights beside an aquatic plant and glass cylinder.
10. Aquarium liquid test kit with five small transparent test tubes in rack and reagent dropper bottles. Liquids colorless; no implied diagnostic colors.
11. Digital pen-type pH meter with screen turned away beside one clear beaker of water.
12. Dry unused white test strips beside a closed strip container and aquarium; no colored result pads.
13. Small gray unknown metal sample on balance, measuring cylinder and notebook; uncertainty investigation.
14. Close view of repeated-water-test equipment with stoppered vials and closed quality-control notebook.
15. Aquarium water change setup: clean bucket, siphon tubing and planted tank.
